name: Sleet
description: Thin diagonal streaks with a bright head and a fading tail, crossing a card or a section.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of streaks. Each crosses once per loop and then waits.

props.name: angle
props.description: Direction of travel in degrees, clockwise from straight up. Streaks start on the edges they travel away from.

props.name: color
props.description: Tail colour. The head is mixed from it: ice white in the dark theme, ink in the light theme.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the streaks. Style it as the card or section. Other div props are passed through.
